description: Navigation element used to switch between different views or data sets.

name: Date-Picker/Mobile
description:
**Overview:** A mobile-optimized date/time picker using scrollable drum-roll wheels instead of a calendar grid.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use on mobile or touch screens for date, time, or date-time entry.
- ✅ Use in bottom sheets or modals on small screens where a full calendar grid would be cramped.
- ❌ DO NOT use on desktop — use Date-Picker/Single-Calendar instead.

**Props / Variants:** Mode (Date / Time / DateTime), Min Date, Max Date.

**Original Notes:** Mobile-optimized scroll-wheel date and time picker.

name: Date-Picker/Single-Calendar
description:
**Overview:** A calendar widget for selecting a single date or a start/end date range, displayed inline or in a popover.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use for event scheduling, booking flows, report date filtering, or date-of-birth selection.
- ✅ Use the range variant for Start Date / End Date pairs (e.g., hotel check-in/check-out).
- ❌ DO NOT use for time-only selection — pair with a time-picker module.
- ❌ DO NOT embed a full calendar when a simple Input/Date-Field with inline picker is sufficient.

**Props / Variants:** Mode (Single/Range), Selected Date(s), Disabled Dates, Event Markers, Header Navigation.

**Original Notes:** Calendar interface for single date and date-range selection.

name: Side-Bar/Master/Small-Density
description:
**Overview:** A compact, icon-only collapsed variant of the primary sidebar navigation, maximizing content area width.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use when screen real estate is limited or users prefer a minimal navigation footprint.
- ✅ Use as the collapsed state of an expand/collapse sidebar interaction.
- ❌ DO NOT use without icon tooltips — with labels hidden, icons must be self-explanatory and tooltips are required for accessibility.

**Props / Variants:** Icon-Only Mode, Active State, Expand/Collapse Trigger, Section Dividers.

**Original Notes:** Compact icon-only sidebar for space-constrained desktop layouts.

name: Side-Bar/Master/Workspace
description:
**Overview:** An extended sidebar variant with workspace-level navigation, supporting multi-workspace/organization switching alongside standard nav items.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use for SaaS applications with multiple workspaces, organizations, or tenants (e.g., Slack, Notion, Linear).
- ✅ Use alongside a standard sidebar for two-level navigation: workspace switcher on the far left + nav items.
- ❌ DO NOT use for simple single-workspace or single-tenant apps — Side-Bar/Master/Basic is sufficient.

**Props / Variants:** Workspace Switcher, Workspace Name/Avatar, User Profile, Menu Items, Sub-Navigation.

**Original Notes:** Extended sidebar with workspace switching for multi-tenant applications.
